defs.def: to be the right shape and size for sb/sth 不用于进行时

ex.s: At first, everything went wrong — the plastic broke, the printer jammed, and the pieces didn’t fit together.
ex.t: 几周后，我又去了农场。

ex.s: You have to balance creating an ending that's unpredictable, but doesn’t seem to come from nowhere, one that fits what’s right for the characters.
ex.t: 你必须平衡：创造一个不可预测但又不能凭空而来的结局，一个适合角色发展的结局。

ex.s: She asked me which one fitted the poem.
ex.t: 她问我哪一首与诗歌最匹配。

ex.s: If your child enjoys being in the kitchen, then the culinary camp is definitely the right fit.
ex.t: 营员们将学习烤、炸、切的技术技能，以及一些可以带回家与家人分享的食谱。

ex.s: But it makes you fit.
ex.t: 但它能让你健美。

ex.s: It's not just corporate jobs, or even paid work that can help keep your brain fit, Then points out.
ex.t: 不只是公司工作，甚至付费工作才能帮助你保持大脑健康，滕指出。

ex.s: Significantly, all Harbour Air routes last less than 30 minutes, making it perfectly fit for electric engines.
ex.t: 值得注意的是，所有港湾航空的航线时长都不到30分钟，这使其非常适合使用电动发动机。

ex.s: I had always been fascinated with chemistry, biology, and math, but since those interests hadn't fit.
ex.t: 我不知道是什么让我决定在新学校尝试一些新活动的，但有一天我偶然参加了科学奥林匹克队的课后会议。

ex.s: Keeping Fit by Eating Smart
ex.t: 通过聪明饮食来保持健康

ex.s: 36   Working out in the morning provides additional benefits beyond being physically fit.
ex.t: 36____早晨锻炼除了身体健康外还有额外的好处。

ex.s: She and her family bicycle to work, _________ helps them keep fit.
ex.t: 中国的高速铁路在过去几年中从9000公里增加到25000公里。

ex.s: Today, the debate continues over how well the gray wolf is fitting in at Yellowstone.
ex.t: 今天，关于灰狼在黄石的适应情况如何，争论仍在继续。

ex.s: When I was rejected from one that had seemed like a perfect fit, it was undoubtedly difficult.
ex.t: 当我被一个看似完美匹配的项目拒绝时，无疑是很困难的。

ex.s: This ability to recognize that a shape will need to be turned in a specific direction before it will fit is called an “allocentric frame of reference”.
ex.t: 这种识别形状需要朝特定方向旋转才能放入的能力被称为"异中心参照系"。

ex.s: This is why, in part at least, the US National Climate Assessment says that: ＂There is no ‘one-size fits all’ adaptation.＂ Nevertheless, there are some actions that offer much and carry little risk or cost.
ex.t: 这就是为什么美国国家气候评估在某种程度上说："没有'一刀切'的适应方案。"尽管如此，有些行动收益很大而风险或成本很低。

defs.def: to be of the right size, type or number to go somewhere （大小、式样、数量适合）可容纳，装进
to put clothes on sb and make them the right size and shape 试穿（衣服）

ex.s: put the students in a class that fits them
ex.t: in terms ofD. in agreement with

defs.def: to put or fix sth somewhere 安置，安装（在某处）
to put or join sth in the right place 合上；盖上；组合；组装

ex.s: fit the environment better            D. make the loudest call
ex.t: 更好地适应环境            D. 发出最大的叫声

defs.def: to agree with, match or be suitable for sth; to make sth do this 不用于进行时
to make sb/sth suitable for a particular job 使适合，使胜任（某工作）

ex.s: As I just wanted a job in my home city, I didn’t ___22___ much whether it fit my interests.
ex.t: 渐渐地，这些不同种类的生物相互适应，形成了自己的生态系统。

defs.def: to find time to see sb or to do sth 找到时间（见某人、做某事）

ex.s: You and your partner will probably have different skills. ___40___ Over time, both of you will benefit — your partner will be able to lift more weights and you will become more physically fit.
ex.t: 你和你的伴侣可能有不同的技能。___40___随着时间的推移，你们双方都会受益——你的伴侣将能够举起更重的重量，而你将变得更加健康。

defs.def: to find or have enough space for sb/sth in a place 找到足够的地方；有足够空间
healthy and strong, especially because you do regular physical exercise 健壮的；健康的

ex.s: the tempting foods and our efforts to keep fit
ex.t: 诱人的食物和我们保持健康的努力

ex.s: He’s only 25 and still very fit.
ex.t: 他才25岁，身体仍然很健壮。

ex.s: First of all, decide what you want from that person. ___37___ Or do you just want to be physically fit, able to move with strength and flexibility?
ex.t: 首先，确定你想从那个人那里得到什么。___37___或者你只是想身体健康，能够有力且灵活地活动？

ex.s: The difficulty of keeping fit.
ex.t: 保持健康的难度。

ex.s: Five percent of the highly fit women developed dementia, compared to 25 percent of the women with medium fitness and 32 percent of the women with low fitness.
ex.t: 5%的高度健康女性患上痴呆症，相比之下中等健康女性为25%，低健康女性为32%。

defs.def: suitable; of the right quality; with the right qualities or skills （质量、素质或技能）适合的，恰当的，合格的

ex.s: Medical certificate：You must provide a medical certificate indicating you are fit to work．
ex.t: 医疗证明：你必须提供医疗证明表明你身体健康可以工作．

defs.def: ready or likely to do sth extreme 可能（或准备）做某事至极端程度

ex.s: New researchers found that middle-aged women who were physically fit could be nearly 90 percent less likely to develop dementia in later life, and as they did, it came on a decade later than less sporty women.
ex.t: 新研究发现，身体健康的中年女性晚年患痴呆症的可能性可能降低近90%，而且发病时间比不太爱运动的女性晚十年左右。

ex.s: Fit Women Are Less Likely to Develop Dementia
ex.t: 健康的女性更不容易患痴呆症

ex.s: But they must realize that the employment market is about how an employee will be a good fit for a company, not the other way around.
ex.t: 说明：将下列句子翻译成英语，使用括号中给出的词语。

defs.def: a sudden attack of an illness, such as epilepsy, in which sb becomes unconscious and their body may make violent movements （癫痫等的）突发，发作；昏厥；痉挛

ex.s: If we keep our body fit, we can enjoy life in a better manner.
ex.t: 如果我们保持身体健康，我们可以更好地享受生活。

defs.def: a sudden short period of coughing or of laughing, that you cannot control 一阵（忍不住的咳嗽、笑）
a short period of very strong feeling （强烈感情）发作，冲动
the way that sth, especially a piece of clothing, fits 常与形容词连用

ex.s: It fits with the story development.
ex.t: 它符合故事发展。

ex.s: For the blanks with a given word, fill in each blank with the proper form of the given word; for the other blanks, use one word that best fits each blank.
ex.t: 我们还不知道这是否是一件坏事。

ex.s: Fill in each blank with the word or phrase that best fits the context .
ex.t: 当17岁的夸特罗·穆瑟和朋友聚会时，他们不喝啤酒也不和约会对象开车兜风。相反，他们坚持参加攀岩或谈论书籍等适合所有年龄的活动。

ex.s: Choose the one that fits best according to the information given in the passage you have just read.
ex.t: 显然，不与特定银行或特定国家挂钩的货币这一概念对许多人很有吸引力。

defs.def: the way that two things match each other or are suitable for each other 匹配；相配

ex.s: She still has smooth skin and straight black hair, and jogging has kept her slim and fit.
ex.t: 她仍然有光滑的皮肤和黑色直发，慢跑使她保持苗条和健康。

ex.s: It fits into most sport bags.
ex.t: 它能放进大多数运动包里。

ex.s: Some animals have even changed their living habits to fit in with their new homes.
ex.t: 一些动物甚至改变了它们的生活习性与新家园。

ex.s: Now I exercise a couple of times a week but just to keep fit.
ex.t: 现在我每周锻炼几次，但只是为了保持健康。

ex.s: Add to that rotten potatoes, and you have a meal fit for a king!
ex.t: 再加上腐烂的土豆，你就有了一顿适合国王享用的美餐！
